remarks: INVESTORS-THIS IS THE ONE THAT MAKES SENSE AND MAKES MONEY. Perfect for the savvy investor seeking reliable cash flow, or the owner-occupant looking to live smart while your tenants help with the mortgage. House, garage, and property to be sold AS-IS. A rare opportunity to secure a solid multi-family in a proven rental market-start (or level up) your investment portfolio here.  ****Highest and best by Tuesday, February 17th at noon. No escalation clauses, no love letters and seller suggest all offers to be on purchase agreement and not standard form real estate contract.*****
